name: elevenlabs
summary: Completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs SDK and python-dotenv, created example.py following the quickstart code, and ran it. The script successfully called the ElevenLabs text-to-speech API and generated a valid MP3 audio file (output.mp3, 43,511 bytes, MPEG ADTS layer III, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, mono). The `play()` function also reported success. The promised outcome — Text-to-speech generates an audio file from text — is verified.
deviations: The quickstart's `play(audio)` line was modified to first collect audio chunks into a list so they could be saved to a file for verification, then replayed for the `play()` call. This was necessary because the audio generator is consumed on first iteration. Additionally, the sandbox has no audio hardware, so while `play()` reported success, actual speaker playback was not verified — but the core outcome (generating an audio file from text) was fully achieved and confirmed via `file` command showing a valid MP3.
